title: Taiwanese Association of America Boston 波士頓台灣同鄉會
content_html: The Taiwanese Association of America Boston (波士頓台灣同鄉會) is the Boston-area chapter of the Taiwanese Association of America (TAA, 全美台灣同鄉會), the national umbrella organization serving Taiwanese American communities across the United States. The chapter serves the greater Boston, Massachusetts region.
